hero.subtitle: Precision Measurement Technology
hero.title: TRACKER™ Tensiometer
hero.paragraph1: TRACKER™ calculates the dynamic surface tension between two immiscible fluids using Axisymmetric Drop Shape Analysis (ADSA), a precise numerical method based on the profile of a drop or bubble.
hero.paragraph2: It is the only optical surface tensiometer that measures interfacial rheology and adsorption kinetics with precise drop/bubble volume control, fully automated through the software. This makes it a powerful tool to:
hero.check1: Understand the behavior of molecules and their interactions at interfaces
hero.check2: Assess the hydrophobic/hydrophilic character of surfaces
hero.check3: Differentiate the foaming and emulsifying properties of surface-active molecules

dropShape.title: Drop Shape Analysis
dropShape.subtitle: Laplace-Young Drop Shape Analysis
dropShape.description: TRACKER™ uses advanced algorithms to analyze the shape of liquid drops or bubbles, precisely calculating surface and interfacial tension according to the Laplace-Young equation. This enables accurate, reliable measurements even for challenging systems.

modules.subtitle: Optional Modules
modules.title: TRACKER™ Modules
modules.description: Enhance your TRACKER™ with specialized modules for advanced research and expanded capabilities.

items.title: TRACKER™ Dense Phase Exchange module
items.description: A double pump exchanges the liquid in the cuvette by another liquid while keeping the volume of the drop or bubble constant. The phase exchange can be automated or controlled manually. All regulations can be carried out during phase exchange.

items.title: TRACKER™ Drop Phase Exchange module
items.description: A double injection system exchanges the liquid or gas in the drop or bubble by another liquid or gas while keeping the volume of the drop or bubble constant. All types of measurements can be performed during phase exchange.

items.title: TRACKER™ CMC
items.description: An Automated critical micelle concentration measurement system is added to TRACKER™ standard. A second injection system allows to measure up to 4 solutions of different concentrations. The injected volume and concentration are determined by an algorithm that calculates the concentration steps in order to optimise the accuracy of the CMC determination. The drop volume control allows the volume of the drop to be automatically adjusted according to the concentration.

items.title: TRACKER™ Piezoelectric module
items.description: A piezoelectric ceramic is added to TRACKER™ standard to achieve an oscillation frequency up to 10 Hz.

items.title: TRACKER™ Pressure Cell 200°C/200bars
items.description: A removable Pressure Cell for High Temperature and High Pressure measurements can be adapted to TRACKER™ standard. All measurements with pendant drop or rising drop, sessile drop or capture bubble can be performed.

items.title: TRACKER™ Pressure Sensor
items.description: The sensor measures the hydrostatic pressure above the bubble in liquid or the pressure of a bubble of air in air (soap bubble). The pressure sensor is a good tool to characterize that a membrane has formed at the surface and that the interface is no more 'liquid'. Combined with the piezoelectric cell, the Pressure sensor is also used to measure surface tension at High frequency oscillations.

cards.title: Pendant & Rising Drop
cards.description: Measure surface and interfacial tension using pendant or rising drop methods for a wide range of liquids and interfaces.

cards.title: Sessile Drop & Captive Bubble
cards.description: Analyze contact angle and wettability with sessile drop and captive bubble techniques for solid and liquid surfaces.
